pilot.positioning: Yavatmal regional agricultural / vegetation monitoring pilot, designed around the cotton intervention use case. Monitoring cells are regional sampling locations, not farmer fields and not verified cotton fields.

satellite.source: NASA MODIS/Terra via ORNL DAAC TESViS

regional_condition.basis: latest usable composite per cell; medians over cells observed in the latest composite

alerts.note: Configurable rule threshold; not a universally validated crop-damage threshold.

weather.note: Alerts evaluated at the central monitoring cell YVT_CELL_020.

operational_kpis.note: Operational counts only. No yield, income or loss-prevention figures are estimated.

gate_reasons: All gate criteria met on the temporally held-out test set.
caveats: Calibration gain is marginal: Brier 0.122 vs 0.126 for a prevalence-only forecast (<5% improvement). Treat probabilities as a ranking aid, not precise risk estimates.
PR-AUC fell from 0.339 (validation) to 0.255 (temporal test): performance varies between seasons.

The heuristic baseline ranks worse than random on this label (ROC-AUC 0.39): cells already below baseline tend to recover at the next composite. Beating it is therefore a weak bar; the comparison with prevalence is the meaningful one.

The strongest feature is the current anomaly. Part of the predictive signal is regression to the mean in a noisy anomaly measure (a cell well above its baseline is more likely to fall back), not only genuine stress onset.
Discrimination on the temporal test is modest (ROC-AUC 0.63).

limitations: Monitoring cells are ~2.25 km regional sampling squares of 250 m MODIS pixels, not farmer fields and not verified cotton fields.
No verified crop mask is used; signals describe mixed vegetation/cropland within each cell.
MOD13Q1 is a 16-day maximum-value composite released with a delay of roughly 1-3 weeks; it cannot detect very recent changes.
Seasonal baselines use prior seasons since 2019 only (median of the same period of year); they are vegetation-season, not crop-specific, baselines.
Weather values are gridded Open-Meteo reanalysis/model data, not station measurements; water balance ignores irrigation.
Risk is the transparent heuristic_v1 score, not a validated agronomic model; no pest or disease can be inferred from these signals.
NDMI is not available from MOD13Q1 and is left missing.
